inputs.text: Nigeria’s democracy is facing a transformation that is both alarming and largely underexamined, as political parties—once intended to be platforms for representation and public service—are increasingly becoming exclusive clubs for the wealthy. The latest developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections make this trend painfully clear.

output.main_topic: Political parties in Nigeria becoming exclusive clubs for the wealthy
subtopics: Political parties’ intended role in representation and public service
Developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections

central_relations.object: platforms for representation and public service

central_relations.action: has latest developments that make clear
central_relations.object: the trend of political parties becoming exclusive clubs for the wealthy

opinions: The transformation is alarming and largely underexamined.
